授業科目の概要.科目名称: Japanese Banking and Financial Systems in a Globalized world
授業科目の概要.講義題目: Japanese Banking and Financial Systems in a Globalized World
授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
Course Description
This course provides a comprehensive introduction to Japanese banking
and financial systems. As known, the Japanese banking industry is among
the largest in the world. The financial system, particularly its banking
sector, has been taking a significant role in the development of Japanese
economy. In academic field of banking and finance, there are many
universal basic concepts, however, the Japanese financial system
especialy banking system has its unique aspects. In this course, we wil
first introduce some basic concepts about banking and related theories as
wel. Then, we wil look at the Japanese banking and financial systems in a
globalized world. We wil compare Japan and other countries’ banking
systems and try to find out some common and disparate among various
countries. We wil focus on the roles and implications of Japanese banking
financial systems. Participants are encouraged to deliver presentations and discuss with each other in the class.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: グローバル化世界における日本の銀行・金融システムを理解する。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: To understand Japan's Banking and Financial System in a Globalized World.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: nternational Finance, World Economy, Banking System, Financial System
